name: Rio Vista Delta Breeze: Paratransit
description: Priority dial-a-ride for ADA-certified riders in Rio Vista
fullDescription: Rio Vista Delta Breeze gives ADA-certified paratransit riders priority on its Dial-A-Ride service in Rio Vista. Delta Breeze runs weekdays only, with no service on weekends or holidays.
whatTheyOffer:
- Priority Dial-A-Ride service for ADA-certified riders
- Service within Rio Vista (Delta Breeze buses also connect to Isleton, Fairfield, and Suisun City)
- Advance reservations required
- Weekdays only, about 5 am-7:30 pm
- Wheelchair lift-equipped vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Get ADA paratransit certification (riders certified anywhere in the Bay Area qualify)
2. Contact Delta Breeze at 707-374-2878 to ask how to apply
3. Assessment may be required
4. Once certified, call 707-374-2878 to reserve or cancel a trip
keywords: Rio Vista, Delta Breeze, paratransit, ADA, Solano County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
